description: WatchGuard offers critical network security solutions for businesses of all types and sizes, including everything from tabletop and rack-mounted appliances. Firebox appliances deliver a broad range of critical security services, from standard IPS, URL filtering, gateway AV, application control, and antispam, to advanced protections such as file sandboxing, DNS filtering, and more. High-performance deep packet inspection (DPI) means you can leverage all our security services against attacks attempting to hide in encrypted channels like HTTPS. Additionally, every Firebox offers SD-WAN right out of the box for improved network resiliency and performance.
